_doc: Locked stack for sylvain-builder. Verified against official sources. ADR required for any major bump. See web-references.instructions.md for canonical URLs.
notes: Spring Boot 4.x manages Hibernate, Tomcat, Jackson, Testcontainers — do not pin manually.

Spring AI 2.0.0-M6 is a milestone (pre-release). APIs may change before GA. Key breaking changes vs 1.x: PromptChatMemoryAdvisor removed, all options builder-only (no setters), Jackson 3 (tools.jackson), explicit conversationId required for all chat memory advisors.
React 19.2.6 includes the Dec 2025 RSC CVE fixes (DoS + source code exposure).
eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.x supports ESLint 10 and adds new compiler-aware rules.
Vite 8 drops Node 18 support; requires Node 20.19+ / 22.12+ / 24+.
TypeScript 6.0 enforces stricter ESM + new lib targets — see ADR.
OWASP LLM Top 10 2025 governs Spring AI tool/function calling and RAG.
